description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and the accuracy of two different models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, in a certain task. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and is a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35. The line representing GPT-4o is marked with blue circles and a solid line, while the line representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet is marked with blue crosses and a dashed line. The GPT-4o line starts at an accuracy of 26.7% with 1 child node, increases to 28.9% with 3 child nodes, peaks at 34.4% with 5 child nodes, and then decreases to 31.1% with 7 child nodes. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line starts at an accuracy of 24.4% with 1 child node, increases to 27.8% with 3 child nodes, decreases to 24.4% with 5 child nodes, and further decreases to 20.0% with 7 child nodes.
